title: THE SEAL OPENS IN TWO THIRDS OF THE TIME AND CALLS A WAVE
why: His order of 10-31: make the seal 50 percent faster to open, and make enemies spawn and attack when you start opening it. The need is now two thirds of the old one at every stage (23, 37, 51 and on). The first frame of cutting calls one wave of machines on the opener from 700 to 1000 away, a few more arrive one by one while the cut runs, once per seal per raid; a teammate window asks the host, which runs the wave for the party. Draws are on the effects side stream.
now: The seal opens in two thirds of the time but calls a wave of machines on you the moment you start cutting it.
